SVRRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Alamance County in central North Carolina...
Southern Orange County in central North Carolina...
Northeastern Chatham County in central North Carolina...
Southwestern Durham County in central North Carolina...

* Until 345 PM EDT.

* At 243 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Mebane, or 9
miles southeast of Graham, moving southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Durham, Chapel Hill, Carrboro, Efland, Bynum, Fearrington, Cane
Creek Reservoir, Saxapahaw, and Jordan Lake.

This includes Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 155 and 160, near
Mile Marker 260, and between Mile Markers 262 and 276.

events.summary:
At 140 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Williamsville to near Edinburg to near Kincaid, moving
east at 55 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Taylorville, Kincaid, Williamsville, Edinburg, Mechanicsburg,
Dawson, Buffalo, Mount Auburn, Jeisyville, and Cornland around 145

Interstate 72 between mile markers 98 and 123.

events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of southeast West Virginia, including the
following counties, Greenbrier and Summers.

* WHEN...Until 430 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 236 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Big Clear Creek, Elijah Branch, Big Creek, Beech Run, Eagle
Branch, Bradshaw Creek, Burns Run, Beaver Creek, Fisher
Creek, Burdette Creek, Buggy Branch, Boggs Creek, Greenbrier
River and Boone Creek.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Hinton, Rainelle, Alderson, Rupert, Quinwood, Sandstone and
Meadow Bluff.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

* Tornado Warning for...
Western Belmont County in east central Ohio...
Central Guernsey County in east central Ohio...
Northeastern Noble County in east central Ohio...

* Until 300 PM EDT.

* At 237 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing a tornado
were located along a line from near Cambridge to 6 miles southeast

southeast of Cambridge, moving east at 45 mph.

Cambridge, Barnesville, Byesville, Bethesda, Antrim, Quaker City,
Senecaville, Belmont, Lore City, Morristown, Old Washington,
Salesville, Somerton, Fairview, Batesville, Seneca Lake Park,

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...The island of Kauai in Kauai County...

* WHEN...Until 1130 AM HST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding on roads, poor drainage areas, and in
streams.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 828 AM HST, Doppler radar indicated a large band of moderate
to locally heavy rain moving over the entire island. The largest
rainfall totals over the last hour are focused on the interior
higher terrain. Rain was falling at a rate of 0.5 to 1.5 inches
per hour. Water levels in several streams across the island are
also beginning to rise. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to
begin shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Lihue, Kapaa, Kalaheo, Kekaha, Princeville, Kilauea, North Fork
Wailua Trails, Alakai Swamp Trails, Lawai, Omao, Kokee State Park
and Wailua Homesteads.
